Music Practice

What are you working on today? Pick the task closest to it; each one starts you on the best page for the job, with a line on why.

Show for:

Learn a song from a recording

  • Timestamp Notes — load a YouTube link or file, stamp the sections, tap the bars, loop phrase by phrase.
  • Tap Along — the same mapping on a phone, while the song plays in another app.
  • Mapping a Recording — the lesson that walks you through it.
  • Also: Naming sections, Chunk Practice for the fast bits

Play along with a band

  • Backing Track — type or paste chords, pick a style, and a full band plays them.
  • Styles — swing to reggaeton: hear what each groove does before you choose.
  • Your first rock song — a guided first session with the band.
  • Also: Drum Set, Accompaniment styles

Write down a melody

  • Notation — play it in on a MIDI keyboard or type letters; add chords and words, then hear it.
  • Write an Ending — finish an unfinished song's last two bars.
  • Dictation — hear a line, write it, get it marked note by note.
  • Also: Notation choices, Notation rules

Tune and set up my guitar

  • Guitar Tuning — tune by ear six ways, any tuning, with the mic as a check.
  • Setup Check — buzz, action, relief, intonation: what to adjust, and who should.
  • Tuning by ear — why the ear comes first.
  • Also: Strobe tuner, Harmonics

Learn chords on my instrument

  • Chord Library — every shape, with the lessons that teach it.
  • Pop changes: guitar, piano, bass — the four-chord songs, on your instrument.
  • Guitar chord shapes or piano chord shapes — the first shapes and the hand that makes them.
  • Also: Inversions, Scales

Warm up and train my voice

  • Vocal Warm-up — a routine built for you: stretches, breath, piano-led patterns, a groove.
  • Pop voice — mic, style and stamina for pop singing.
  • Vowels and formants — drag a vowel and hear why it carries.
  • Also: Jazz voice, Classical voice, IPA chart

Get grooves into my hands

  • Hi-hat grooves — the kit drawn from above, lit as the band plays.
  • Congas basics — the tones and the tumbao, then play along.
  • Blues drums — shuffle and swing feels with the band.
  • Also: Grips, Brushes, Cajón

Understand harmony

  • Four-chord loops — the progressions behind a thousand songs.
  • Cadences — how phrases end, and how to hear it.
  • Blues changes — the twelve bars, and what players do with them.
  • Also: Borrowed chords, Guide tones, Reharmonize, Circle of fifths

Improvise and arrange

  • Blues improvisation — your first solos over a band.
  • Arranging for a band — who plays what, and when to stay out.
  • Reading swing — play the written line; get graded on the feel.
  • Also: Organ parts, Stride and boogie

Record and mix

  • Gain staging — set levels before anything else.
  • Microphones and recording a voice — pick and place a mic, hear it change.
  • DAW basics — a small DAW in the page, up to your first real session.
  • Also: Mixing, Mastering, Cables

DJ or make beats from samples

  • DJ gear — two decks and a mixer in the page; then beatmatching.
  • What a sample is — then chop one onto pads.
  • Build a beat — chops, pads and a quantized pattern.
  • Also: Plan a set, Sampling and the law

Design sounds with synths

  • Harmonics — where every sound starts.
  • Subtractive synthesis — oscillator, filter, envelope: the classic synth.
  • Effects chain — put EQ, compression and space in order.
  • Also: FM, Chiptune, Amps

Build reading, rhythm and ear

  • Rhythm Sequences — rhythm vocabulary, pattern by pattern.
  • Tonal Sequences — melodic patterns by ear and by sight.
  • Reading Benchmarks — graded lines to read at sight.
  • Also: Tonal Patterns, Rhythm Patterns, Song Builder

Test my pitch and rhythm

  • Tune Assessment — perform a tune; scored on pitch and rhythm.
  • Tonal Accuracy — sing or play back patterns on demand.
  • Rhythmic Accuracy — perform rhythms and see your timing.

Set work and follow progress

  • Session Builder — write a guided practice session and share the link.
  • Teacher Report — time on task, plays and notes, by student.
  • All lessons — filter by instrument and topic to find one to assign.
  • Also: Every interactive tool
